title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.316 - Added `permissions.blockReadsExemptPaths` to the `Settings` type: paths, read only from `--settings` and settings the host sends, that `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` lets through without making them working directories - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.316 ## 0.3.315 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.315 ## 0.3.314 - Added `sandbox_required_unavailable` to `startup_failure_reason`, for the result Claude Code writes when a required sandbox cannot run - Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories` to the `Settings` type - Added `prewarm()` (alpha) to the `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/core` entry point
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
